findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_topup_link · Private data: register_agent, rotate_principal_key, list_agents, revoke_agent, renew_mandate, purchase, get_wallet, get_topup_link, request_refund, sandbox_simulate_topup_payment · Public sink: register_agent, get_wallet, sandbox_simulate_topup_payment · Destructive: sandbox_simulate_topup_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_topup_link · Private data: register_agent, rotate_principal_key, list_agents, revoke_agent, renew_mandate, purchase, get_wallet, get_topup_link, request_refund, sandbox_simulate_topup_payment · Public sink: register_agent, get_wallet, sandbox_simulate_topup_payment · Destructive: sandbox_simulate_topup_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
